profiles.name: CoD: Gyro aim
profiles.author: dxo
profiles.description: Hold L2 to aim with the gyro, right stick for big turns. Weapon click on R2.

profiles.name: CoD: Classic precision
profiles.author: dxo
profiles.description: Sticks only. Small deadzones and a curve that slows the first part of the stick for fine aim.

profiles.name: CoD: Edge paddles
profiles.author: dxo
profiles.description: Jump and slide on the back paddles so your thumb stays on the right stick.

profiles.name: Forza Horizon 5: Pedal feel
profiles.author: dxo
profiles.description: Brake resistance on L2, light throttle on R2, fine steering.

profiles.name: Forza Horizon 5: Gentle steering
profiles.author: dxo
profiles.description: Soft steering near the centre for smooth corners; stronger low rumble for road feel.

profiles.name: Elden Ring: Comfort
profiles.author: dxo
profiles.description: Touchpad opens the map; smoothed camera stick; amber breathing light.
